mapper.sql: FROM retrip_review r JOIN retrip_place p ON p.id = r.place_id LEFT JOIN review_embedding e ON e.review_id = r.id WHERE e.review_id IS NULL AND split_part(p.address, ' ', 2) IN ('중구', '종로구', '강남구', '용산구', '영등포구')
